interpretation: No result establishes an explicit software release calendar date together with requested model applicability. Index-only associations do not qualify.
Reused Cisco c9500h workbook dates and ISSU supplemental dates remain restricted to their originally stated platforms. They do not transfer to C9200/C9300.
Reused Arista 10-Oct-2024 is a 4.33.x train initial date; 23-Oct-2026 is image revision date. Neither establishes a literal binary/model release date.
EOS RSS availability/announcement dates, TOI dates, certification approvals, document updates and advisory notice dates are excluded from software release dates.
The 17.9.6 action is unverified, not disproved. CLI command removal, version absence from an index and existence of a later rebuild cannot prove withdrawal/deferral.
Search results mix query outcomes; the serialized combined response is retained without claiming an empty per-query result is a complete archive search.
stop_reason: Bounded repeat pass returned the same index/document dates, security/certification context, command-removal and unrelated WLC material. Existing detailed origin captures and known access gates were not retried. Unknown is retained; this is not proof no public source exists.
